KV_Actors.description: Folder of the actor bodies (players and enemies); ActorRenderController's render step.

KV_AffixRings.description: Folder of the elite affix rings; AffixRingController's render step.

KV_AllowDebugRuns.description: Run validation accepts debug input bits and boss-door starts, so runs played with the debug keys (K / J) or KV_SpawnBoss can be validated while developing.

KV_AnalyticsDebug.description: TelemetryService echoes every analytics and economy event to the server log; in Studio it also lets runs count in the new-player window. Set on the server (a client's own copy is never read).

KV_Audio.description: Folder under SoundService holding the pooled Sounds.

KV_BoostAuras.description: Folder of the boost aura rings round players; their render step.

KV_BossBarPlacement.description: BossBarPlacementController's render step (places the boss bar each frame).

KV_Breakables.description: Folder of the breakable pieces and their decals; BreakableRenderController's render step.

KV_BuildFx.description: Folder of the build boons' effect parts.

KV_BulletTrails.description: Folder of the build bullets' trails.

KV_Bullets.description: Folder of the bullet parts; BulletRenderController's render step.

KV_Census.description: Set by the headless spec runner's `--census` flag (scripts/lune/run-tests.luau): census specs run their full sample instead of the small default one.

KV_Codex_v1.description: DataStore of the Codex: one doc per player of the entries seen and found.

KV_CollisionDebug.description: Draws the collision overlay (the blocking cells and the bodies) while true; read live. Presentation only.

KV_ComboDebug.description: Each change forces one combo event on the next frame of a scored run: "1".."4" a tier-up, "break", "small", "lapse" or "cut". Display and sound only.

KV_ComboShout.description: Folder of the combo's floor shout.

KV_CounterWaves.description: Folder of the Riposte counter-wave rings.

KV_Cursor.description: The gauntlet cursor's ScreenGui; CursorController's render step.

KV_Daily.description: The main menu's Play solo (and KV_SkipMenu's start) starts the Daily: a ranked run on the server's seed of the day.

KV_DailyRankDebug.description: Forces a daily run's rank baseline: "rows:<count>:<step>", optional "friends:<every>" and "best:<score>" (parseDailyRankDebug). Display only.

KV_DamageNumbers.description: Folder of the damage numbers; DamageNumberController's render step.

KV_Debug.description: The debug keys (K, J, F8) and the debug HUD line; also unlocks the label switches outside Studio. A live server rejects a run that carries debug input.

KV_Decor.description: Folder of the room decor; DecorController's render step.

KV_DecorBand.description: Forces the decor depth band by index (0 = the floor's own); decor and void rebuild at once.

KV_DecorDebug.description: Draws decor fade boxes, footprint stencils and breakable cells; read live. Also the folder of what it draws.

KV_DecorFx.description: Folder of the decor effects (torch flames, motes); DecorFxController's render step.

KV_DevAllowed.description: Player attribute the server sets (true) on players allowed developer mode: everyone in Studio, else an allow-listed UserId or the place's creator. The client opens the dev panel and hidden locales on it.

KV_DevPanel.description: Opens the developer panel as soon as the player is allowed (KV_DevAllowed), without pressing F2.

KV_DraftRevealDebug.description: The next boon reveals' rarities as a list (`c,l,r`): what the cards show while they flip, not what is dealt.

KV_Drops.description: Folder of the boost drops; their render step and profiler label.

KV_EmberSprites.description: Folder of the build embers drawn as sprites.

KV_Embers.description: Folder of the build embers' floor discs.

KV_EnemyBulletSprites.description: Folder of the enemy bullets drawn as sprites.

KV_EnemyOutline.description: false turns every enemy outline off (Highlight and sprite rims); absent = on. Read live.

KV_FakeAssetLatency.description: Seconds the preload worker waits before each chunk, with resolved ids fetched once more, so stage gates and stand-in swaps can be exercised against Studio's cache. Unset or 0: off.

KV_FakeCodex.description: A fake Codex for every player in the session, nothing written: "all", "seen", "none", "unknown" or `<entry>:<tier>` pairs (parseFakeCodex).

KV_FakeFriends.description: UserIds standing in for the friends list on the Daily's friends board (GetFriendsAsync fails in Studio).

KV_FakeInviteEligible.description: Forces the `inviteEligible` answer the lobby's Invite button reads.

KV_FakeInviteRecipients.description: UserIds ("-2,-3") the server treats as the recipients of each invite prompt (Studio never fires GameInvitePromptClosed). Player attribute, else Workspace.

KV_FakeLaunchData.description: Stands in for the join's `LaunchData` (an invite's lobby payload). Player attribute, else Workspace.

KV_FakePartyId.description: Stands in for `Player.PartyId` ("" = no party). Player attribute, else Workspace.

KV_FakePasses.description: Fakes the Robux-only cosmetics' game passes: `off` takes them off sale, one whole Robux price puts them on sale and a press grants into the Studio memory store (parseFakePasses).

KV_FakeRecords.description: Fake personal records for every player in the session, nothing written: `solo:<best>:<floor>,coop:...`, "none" or "unknown" (parseFakeRecords).

KV_FakeShop.description: Fakes the Silver shop: `off` hides it, four whole Robux prices turn it on and a press grants into the Studio memory store (parseFakeShop).

KV_FakeWallet.description: A fake wallet for every player in the session, transactions in memory only: a balance, `<balance>;<item>:<level>,...`, "unknown" (parseFakeWallet).

KV_FloorModifier.description: Read when a dev run starts: a floor modifier's key or number, forced on every floor where it is eligible (parseFloorModifierOverride).

KV_FocusDebug.description: Prints every change of the scope that owns the gamepad and every selection FocusController makes.

KV_FxSprites.description: Folder of the sprite effects; their render step.

KV_FxTracker.description: FxTrackerController's render step (turns sim changes into effect events).

KV_GameHud.description: The in-run HUD's ScreenGui; the touch controls measure its corner panels.

KV_GameInput.description: InputController's ContextActionService action that sinks gameplay input.

KV_GameMenu.description: The ScreenGui of the run overlays (pause menu, draft, run over).

KV_GameMenuDim.description: The full-screen ScreenGui under KV_GameMenu that the overlays dim.

KV_Golden.description: Folder of the Goldling's view; GoldenRenderController's render step and profiler label.

KV_GoldenLabel.description: A label over the Goldling with its status, ticks left and hp.

KV_Goo.description: Folder of the Ooze's goo puddles.

KV_GooSprites.description: Folder of the goo sprite anchors, under the bullets folder.

KV_HapticDebug.description: Any truthy value prints every haptic cue played or dropped; an integer 1-7 also fires that test cue once per change (kill, parry, stagger, boss death, three hurts).

KV_Haptics.description: Folder of the phone HapticEffect instances.

KV_HealthBars.description: Folder of the enemy health bars; HealthBarController's render step.

KV_HeartBeam.description: Folder of the Full Heart beam's parts.

KV_HudOcclusion.description: HudOcclusionController's render step (fades HUD corners over the action).

KV_HudRoot.description: The React root folder of the HUD and menus under PlayerGui.

KV_InviteSpike.description: Runs the invites spike I0: the server makes a ReplicatedStorage folder with a RemoteEvent while on, the client its checks. Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.invites`. Also that folder's name.

KV_InviteSpikeMessageId.description: Invites spike: a Notification String id for `InviteMessageId`; unset = Roblox's default text.

KV_InviteSpikeRecipient.description: Invites spike: the recipient UserId for the with-recipient checks, else the first other player.

KV_L10nSpike.description: Runs the localization spike L0 (its probe ScreenGuis). Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.l10n`. Also its main ScreenGui.

KV_L10nSpikeAuto.description: Localization spike: the probe ScreenGui with AutoLocalize on (the only one ever made so).

KV_LeadBump.description: Read at each co-op run start: builds the client with Revision 2's late bump, for an A/B in a playtest. Ignored with KV_LeadOff.

KV_LeadOff.description: Read at each co-op run start: builds the client without the measured input lead (the legacy miss counter), for an A/B in a playtest.

KV_LoadingRoot.description: The loading screen's React root folder under PlayerGui.

KV_LocaleAudit.description: true starts the fit audit: LocaleAuditController walks PlayerGui on a timer and reports each text that overflows, once.

KV_LootDebug.description: A label with the boost kind over every loaded, intact barrel or crate.

KV_Markings.description: Folder of the floor markings (telegraph dashes, the arena seal).

KV_Menu.description: A made-up GUI name in `focus.spec.ts` paths; no instance has it.

KV_MenuShell.description: The menu layer's ScreenGui (and its React key in HudController).

KV_MinimapLayer.description: The Frame a minimap host draws its tiles and markers in.

KV_NameTags.description: Folder of the co-op name tags.

KV_NewBestDebug.description: Forces the run's new-best baseline: "score:500", "floor:2", both, "first" or "unknown" (parseNewBestDebug). Display only.

KV_NewEnemy2Marks.description: Folder of the New enemies 2 floor marks and flames (the Shieldwall's guard arc); NewEnemy2MarksController's render step.

KV_NewEnemy3Marks.description: Folder of the New enemies 3 floor marks and the Mortar's shell; NewEnemy3MarksController's render step.

KV_NewEnemyMarks.description: Folder of the New enemies floor marks (the Warbanner's aura ring); NewEnemyMarksController's render step.

KV_NoSelectionImage.description: The Name of FocusController's empty SelectionImageObject; the pad spike reads it as "no image".

KV_Onboarding_v1.description: DataStore of onboarding: one doc per player (the tutorial's outcome, first sightings seen, the new-player window's counters).

KV_OvercapPops.description: Folder of the overcap boss point pops; OvercapPopController's render step.

KV_PacingOff.description: Read at each co-op run start: builds the client without the playout clock (frames step as they arrive), for an A/B in a playtest.

KV_PactLabel.description: A label over each pact altar with its status, the Horde phase and the view player.

KV_Pacts.description: Folder of the pact altars; PactRenderController's render step and profiler label.

KV_PadSpike.description: Runs the gamepad spike GM0 (its test ScreenGuis). Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.pad`. Also its main ScreenGui.

KV_PadSpikeInsetProbe.description: Gamepad spike: the ScreenGui that probes the safe-area insets.

KV_PadSpikeTrap.description: Gamepad spike: the ScreenGui that tests a selection trap.

KV_ParryDebug.description: A whole number n >= 1: each change forces one drawn PARRY! flash of n erases on the view player (no sound, sparks or freeze).

KV_ParryFlash.description: Folder of the PARRY! floor flash.

KV_Particles.description: Folder of the particle parts; ParticleController's render step.

KV_PauseButton.description: The pause button's ScreenGui in the Roblox top bar (mouse and touch).

KV_PelletDebug.description: A `left / count` label over every live room's centre.

KV_Pellets.description: Folder of the pellets; PelletRenderController's render step and profiler label.

KV_PlayerBulletSprites.description: Folder of the player bullets drawn as sprites.

KV_PlayerOutline.description: false turns the player outline off (Highlight and sprite rim); absent = on. Read live.

KV_PredictOff.description: Read at each co-op run start: builds the client without local prediction (your knight drawn at the merged state), for an A/B in a playtest.

KV_Purchases_v1.description: DataStore of the Silver shop's best-effort purchase audit log (key `p_<PurchaseId>`): for support only, it never decides a grant.

KV_RecapConfirm.description: RecapController's ContextActionService action for Again / confirm on run over.

KV_RecapTabs.description: RecapController's ContextActionService action that switches the run-over tabs.

KV_Records_v1.description: DataStore of personal records: one doc per player of best scores and deepest floors.

KV_ResetBindings.description: On join, clears this player's saved key bindings once the server's settings arrive; the other settings groups are kept.

KV_ResetOnboarding.description: A joining player's onboarding doc is reset to empty and saved, so the tutorial is offered on every Studio join.

KV_RetryTiming.description: A run-over retry prints `[Recap] retry: press -> control <s> s` once the next run takes input.

KV_RoomEdges.description: Folder of the room-edge dash layers; RoomEdgeController's render step.

KV_RunMarkers.description: Folder of the relic pedestals and the curse shrine's zone; RunMarkerController's render step.

KV_RunValidationWorld.description: The world run validation replays in ("game", "endless", "dungeonNoEncounter" or "greybox"); pair it with the client's KV_World.

KV_Scorches.description: Folder of the scorch marks a strike leaves.

KV_ScorePops.description: Folder of the score pops; ScorePopController's render step.

KV_Scoring.description: M2 scoring on the M1 run (score HUD, combo meter, score pops, results breakdown). Such a run hashes differently and is not submitted.

KV_Secret.description: Folder of the secret room's crack and chamber; SecretRenderController's render step.

KV_SecretDebug.description: Read when a dev run starts, words in any order: `every` puts a secret room on every floor, `rare` / `legendary` fixes its chest's tier (parseSecretDebug).

KV_SecretLabel.description: Outlines the floor's crack, chamber and front box and labels the crack with the chest's tier and the secret's status.

KV_Seed.description: The run's seed, an integer in [0, 2^32); read on every restart. A run on a picked seed is local and unranked (ranked seeds come from the server).

KV_SiegeFx.description: Folder of the Siege Bolt effect parts.

KV_SilverCoins.description: The ScreenGui the flying Silver coins are drawn in.

KV_SilverDebug.description: Read when a dev run starts: `every` makes every candidate barrel and crate hold Silver (parseSilverDebug).

KV_SilverLabel.description: A label with the Silver amount over every barrel or crate that holds Silver.

KV_SilverPops.description: Folder of the Silver amount pops.

KV_Sim.description: SimController's render step: the sim's frame.

KV_SkipLoading.description: Read once on join: releases the join loading screen at once; the download queue still runs behind the menu.

KV_SkipMenu.description: Skips the main menu on join and starts a solo run at once.

KV_SolidStandIns.description: Folder of the stand-in boxes drawn for solid decor still downloading.

KV_SpawnBoss.description: With KV_Debug, outside endless: start just outside the boss room's door. A live server rejects such a run.

KV_SpikeBullets.description: Runs the bullet-count spike. Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.bullets`. Also the spike's Workspace folder.

KV_SpikePreload.description: Runs the preload spike P0 on join; the real preload queue waits for its batches. Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.preload`. Also the spike's ScreenGui.

KV_SpikePreloadInstancesFirst.description: Preload spike: run the instance batches before the string ones.

KV_Stage.description: The stage card's ScreenGui (the cover while a floor loads).

KV_StageAssetAudit.description: Records every logical id the views resolve during a floor and prints those missing from the floor's stage manifest.

KV_StageRenderEnd.description: StageController's render step bound last in the frame.

KV_StageRoot.description: The stage card's React root folder under PlayerGui.

KV_StandInsForce.description: "all" draws every logical id as its stand-in, a comma list of id prefixes ("enemy., bullet.") draws those; read live.

KV_Stress.description: Outside endless: the stress target (the web build's `?stress=N`). Stress runs are never submitted.

KV_StrikeSprites.description: Folder of the Stormcaller strikes drawn as sprites.

KV_Strikes.description: Folder of the strike telegraph and flash parts.

KV_SyncCallout.description: Folder of the co-op SYNC! callout.

KV_SystemCursor.description: Forces Roblox's own pointer everywhere, the gauntlet cursor never drawn: a debug aid and the fallback if an engine update breaks the software cursor.

KV_TeamMomentsDebug.description: Each change arms once: "perfect[:n]" makes the next PERFECT clear a team perfect, "sync", "sync:far" or "sync:3" a SYNC! at the view player. Counts toward nothing.

KV_TouchControls.description: The touch controls' ScreenGui; TouchControlsController's render step.

KV_TouchSpike.description: Runs the touch-input spike (its ScreenGui). Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.touch`. Also its ScreenGui.

KV_TouchStrip.description: The touch HUD strip's ScreenGui; its Footprint folder is measured for the controls' keep-out.

KV_TouchTarget.description: Folder of the touch controls' auto-target marker.

KV_Treasure.description: Folder of the vault's cage and chest; TreasureRenderController's render step.

KV_TreasureDebug.description: Read when a dev run starts, words in any order: `every` puts a vault on every floor, `rare` / `legendary` its tier, `untouched` / `swift` its lock (parseTreasureDebug).

KV_TreasureLabel.description: A label over the vault chest with its lock, tier, status and ticks left / hits.

KV_Tutorial.description: Read once on join: true starts the first-run tutorial whatever the server says, false never starts it; unset, the server's onboarding status decides. Also TutorialController's render step.

KV_TutorialArrow.description: Folder of the tutorial's floor arrow; TutorialArrowController's render step.

KV_TutorialMarker.description: Folder of the tutorial's objective marker; TutorialMarkerController's render step.

KV_UiArtSpike.description: Runs the UI art spike UA1 (its ScreenGui). Overrides `SPIKE_DEFAULTS.uiArt`. Also its ScreenGui.

KV_Void.description: Folder of the void decoration's Parts, rebuilt per floor.

KV_VoidDebug.description: Tints every void layer its debug colour; toggles at once.

KV_VoidOff.description: Builds no void Parts and no abyss motes; toggles at once.

KV_Wallet_v1.description: DataStore of the Silver wallet: one doc per player, changed by transactions only.

KV_World.description: "endless", "game", "dungeonNoEncounter" or "greybox": a local, unranked run in that world on KV_Seed. Also the folder of the world geometry.

KV_WreckerFx.description: Folder of the Wrecker splinter effect parts.
